base: Use case: illustration-story. Create NEW portrait comic page 1024x1536. Exactly TWO equally sized full-width rectangular panels vertically stacked, thin black borders, white outside margin 24px and gutter 24px, top panel y24–744 bottom y768–1512. First attached image is character and setting model sheet, second is approved art style only. Match restrained clean black linework, muted warm-gray cel shading, natural expressive anime human acting, grounded contemporary grocery. Taeo young adult black tousled hair, slightly oversized sage-gray work vest over CHARCOAL hoodie, black pants. NO goblin in these scenes. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, logos, balloons, captions or sound effects; all labels unmarked. EACH panel reserve upper 25 percent for uncomplicated pale wall/window/ceiling negative space suitable for later dialogue; faces and hands remain BELOW that safe upper zone. Continuous shot per panel, no inserts or sub-panels.

pages.prompt: TOP panel1: Early evening establishing view through grocery storefront window, Taeo behind register at right stacking snack packets, middle-aged woman customer short dark bob and beige cardigan waits with green basket at left. Quiet normal workday. BOTTOM panel2: closer register two-shot same customer left with tightened mouth, Taeo right looks from two bottled drinks on counter to a small blank yellow promotion sticker at shelf edge, taking its expired date seriously. Sticker itself blank for later compositing.

TOP panel3: same counter, Taeo at right reaches toward nearby shelf with replacement drinks, politely helpful, customer at left softens and accepts. BOTTOM panel4: wider view, Taeo scans replacement drinks and slides green basket to customer. Behind her the small heavy gray stone porter from model sheet stands in automatic glass doorway clutching stack of delivery crates in its arms; closing glass door bumps projecting crate. Mature utilitarian stone creature, blank simple face, not cute. Delivery worker blue cap and jacket beside doorway.

TOP panel5: delivery man blue cap and jacket pulls blank receipt from pocket while looking down. Behind him heavy stone porter clutching stacked crates has stepped one pace backward out of glass door track and stands rigidly still. BOTTOM panel6: inside entrance Taeo faces porter and gestures toward counter requesting placement; porter ignores him, holding crates still, blank face points straight ahead. Delivery man nearby still distracted. Clear interpersonal staging.

TOP panel7: delivery man bluecap left looks up and points to counter, stone porter middle sets stacked crates down heavily last few centimeters; Taeo right catches falling snack packet off top. Slight action lines without lettering. BOTTOM panel8: same counter medium two-shot Taeo right presses packet back into top crate, wry questioning face toward worker left, worker signs blank delivery sheet with pen while answering dryly. Stone porter quietly behind. Both faces under top negative zone.

TOP panel9: Taeo stands inside looking through glass at departing delivery man bluecap and heavy stone porter following in matching steps outside. Adult woman coworker brown ponytail sage vest white rolled-sleeve blouse leans from back-room doorway at right to address him. BOTTOM panel10: same coworker watches gently as Taeo glances toward round wall clock then sets down next snack packet beside unfinished delivery crates reluctantly taking break. Blank unnumbered clock with hands only.

TOP panel11: cramped grocery break room with lockers and small table. Taeo seated on upturned green crate, heated rice meal on knees, wipes mouth with tissue, phone propped vertically against tissue box on table in foreground; phone shows incoming video portrait of younger teen sibling short black hair yellow shirt, no UI text. BOTTOM panel12: closer over shoulder Taeo tilts meal toward phone camera. Phone large enough to show sibling's face comically too close to camera, playful questioning look; both foreground Taeo cheek and hands visible below upper negative area.

TOP panel13: CLOSE UP of portrait phone propped on tissue box, its display occupies lower two thirds. On screen young teen sibling short black hair warm yellow shirt sitting at dinner table with bowl, grandma's older hand enters screen from right to add piece meat using chopsticks; sibling side-eyes hand. No UI. BOTTOM panel14: reverse angle medium Taeo seated in breakroom, shoulders relax and warm smile speaking to phone, meal on lap. Propped phone turned sufficiently to see sibling puffed full cheeks, yellow shirt and bowl, grandmother only hand. Quiet familial intimacy.

TOP panel15: medium seated Taeo quietly laughing and taking proper bite of rice with chopsticks, phone propped against tissue box visible on small table, screen sibling yellow shirt animated both hands up telling school story. BOTTOM panel16: seated Taeo holding meal turns eyes toward staff schedule pinned beside backroom door, expression shifting from warmth to concern. Phone foreground sibling calmer asks question. Schedule blank simple rectangular grid for later typography, prominently visible at right, no marks or writing.

TOP panel17: closer view Taeo seated in breakroom looking down toward propped phone, small lingering apologetic smile and tired thoughtful eyes, subdued emotionally natural. Phone lower foreground shows sibling short black hair yellow shirt, quiet disappointed expression. BOTTOM panel18: close phone view, sibling has lifted their bowl after looking down, trying cheerful hopeful expression, yellow shirt, dinner room behind, one hand supports bowl. Taeo partial cheek and chopsticks in near foreground looks gently toward sibling. All facial acting lower-middle; upper quarter uncluttered pale negative space.

TOP panel19: quiet breakroom medium close Taeo studies phone held in hand after family call ends, somber slight pause, screen front-facing toward viewer lower center and intentionally blank pale blue rectangular area for banking UI later, no sibling image. Meal on lap nearly finished, tissue box on table. BOTTOM panel20: wider same room Taeo sets phone on table by tissue box and takes last bites from near-empty meal, turning face toward open doorway as coworker calls from shop offscreen; concerned alert look, no coworker visible.
